description: Starlink One-Way Delay Dataset is provided by Resource project or depositing research team (see source). Geographic context: national; Sweden. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. One terminal and one month support one conference paper; the timing setup does not guarantee representativeness elsewhere. Potential simulation use: Calibrate directional satellite-delay models.
